svg.title: 成都天府国际赛道西赛道完整布局
svg.desc: 3.265 km layout. Geometry extracted unchanged from the official 2026 TCR World Tour Chengdu circuit map. Source: https://www.fiatcrworldtour.com/images/2026/Circuits_new/Maps/FIA-TCR-WT_2026_Circuit_CHINA_1.pdf . Labels removed; monochrome presentation. A small opening in the promotional source at the top-left is bridged along the adjacent tangents for small-size legibility; the original path is retained. This is a venue layout, not a confirmed BMW training route.
